scope: 48 independent review findings plus original remaining mitigations, integrated verification, merge and fresh comprehensive review

findings.title: Seven implemented workflows redirect or link to missing canonical pages
Executive overview converts retrieval failures into an all-clear message
findings.notes: Original SSR partial-result trigger removed by 9a30b708; add focused required-source failure and optional-source honesty proof.

findings.title: Resident search entries keep their former facility authorization scope
Saved report variants cannot be run from their own Run Report link
Full reporting exports are built from truncated preview data
Executive subsection navigation excludes keyboard and hides its mobile fallback
The med-tech cockpit is offered to administrators whom the proxy immediately sends home
Standup draft creation can reserve the whole week with missing or partial metrics
Unified Search promises record types the repository never indexes
Executive date-range preferences save but never affect any KPI view
The overtime report counts unapproved punches while labeling the result approved
The med-tech shift and pass queue has no operational producer
The kitchen command deck has no daily service/ticket creation workflow
A family bulletin draft can follow the operator to a different resident
Staff bulletin history hides new messages once a resident exceeds 200 notes
Email/SMS/call delivery selections only save a label
Entering a historical assessment can overwrite the resident's current fall risk
Official discharge leaves the old bed occupied
The discharge workspace has no durable notice/recipient checklist
Controlled-substance count cards omit the resident and dose identity
An interrupted compliance scan becomes the latest scored scan
Saving one referral section erases unsaved work in the others
A complete reconciliation can retain its complete label after required evidence is erased
Medication queue urgency freezes while the cockpit remains open
account disabling leaves database authority active
quality view bypasses tenant and role RLS
observation completion is not atomic or replay-safe
direct observation writes bypass protected completion fields
signing integration authorizes organization but not facility
findings.notes: SYS001D resolves current facility before send/link and revalidates; hosted no-provider-call proof remains.

findings.title: signing retries and webhook duplicates can corrupt local contract state
audit export marks a truncated page as a completed export
facility revocation handler has no routable facility parameter
findings.notes: Owned by lifecycle segment; repair routable facility parameter and verify exact HTTP route.

findings.title: publication receipts are neither immutable nor constrained to the submit transition
Payment success does not confirm invoice application
A failed PO line save leaves an orphan header and duplicates on retry
Retry treats an unposted journal draft as already posted
Insurance review and publication stamps can describe different text
Certification staff-load failures are presented as an empty selector
Payroll exports can retain superseded approved punch values
Local remediation and hosted migration history are not a deployable matched baseline
Activity confirmation has no operational session creation or attendance journey
The latest quality-result view returns conflicting rows for a corrected period
Public inquiry and tour forms confirm work that was never sent or saved
HL7 lead conversion can persist a lead while leaving its inbox item unlinked
Knowledge review completion can succeed without the review event
Manual escalation advances the task without delivering its configured SMS or voice notification
Maintenance work orders persist but lack assignment, worker handoff and a complete backlog
Completing asset service does not update the asset’s service lifecycle
